promises.label: Full year volume growth band
promises.speaker: Amit Syngle
promises.quote: At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27.

promises.label: PBDIT margin guidance
promises.speaker: Amit Syngle
promises.quote: We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.

promises.label: VAM-VAE Phase 1 start
promises.speaker: Amit Syngle
promises.quote: The first phase of this initiative will commence by August. We believe this is a very significant area that we will be entering.

promises.label: Maintain growth momentum
promises.speaker: Amit Syngle
promises.quote: Overall, our priority is very clear that can we maintain the growth momentum which we have seen in the last few quarters.

reported.label: Standalone volume growth
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle
reported.quote: Overall, we are at about a strong 9% volume growth. The growth has been across the months in this entire quarter.

reported.label: Decorative value growth
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle
reported.quote: If you look at the value, the decorative value has grown at a very good pitch of about 16.6%, albeit on a lower base.

reported.label: General industrial growth
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle
reported.quote: When it comes to the General Industrial business, there the growths have been fairly strong. 21% is the overall growth of what we have been able to do.

reported.label: International business growth
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle
reported.quote: This has yielded results. We have grown at about 27% in Q1. This has been a very strong performance.

reported.label: Standalone top line growth
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle
reported.quote: In summary, if you look at the standalone financials, overall top line growth of about 17%.

reported.label: Consolidated top line growth
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle
reported.quote: Consolidated financials almost follow the same route. In fact, it improved to about an 18% top line growth.
